name: Blue Cheese Burger with Cherry-Cranberry Sauce & Lemony Kale

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Place cherries, cranberries, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cup frozen cherries
⅓ cup dried cranberries
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once boiling, gently crush the fruit with the back of a spoon to release juices. Reduce heat to a simmer and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 15-20 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a large bowl.
Wash, dry, and juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl. Use your hands to massage the dressing into the kale until slightly softened; set aside.
Form the ground beef into 6 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and season with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, place patties in the pan and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Work in batches if necessary. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
If desired, place buns, cut-side down, on the grill pan to toast, 1-2 minutes.
Place bottom half of a bun on each plate, then top with burgers, blue cheese, and cherry sauce. Close with the top half of the bun and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese
